dataset: ConceptARC-100-8: 1,600 tasks, each with eight support sets of three examples and ten shared test queries. Only the first support set has been human reviewed. Canonical task IDs and train retain variant 001 for existing links; variants and metadata preserve all source support sets and complete program specifications.
performance: Active ConceptARC-100 main-table means (tab:conceptarc_performance), checked against the appendix means and paired with appendix sample SDs (tab:conceptarc_performance_stdevs). Means and SDs are percentage values. Each aggregate SD is reported across three seeds after concept averaging; it is not an average of concept SDs.
original_performance: Original ConceptARC means and sample SDs from tab:conceptarc_original_performance, for eight LRMs. Values are percentages; all 16 concept means/SDs and predicate, action, and overall aggregates are retained.
robustness: Source-exported means and supplied standard deviations, in fractions. Seed coverage and aggregation are preserved in metric/model metadata. Query accuracy reproduces the active manuscript table independently; do not derive its values from these curves.
separation: summary.csv: position S3, scope global, metric tie_adjusted. Qwen3.5-27B identity verified against manuscript layer 0, 39 and 63 values. Values are fractions.
varc_separation: Four rounded values reported in the manuscript, in fractions. No layerwise VARC series is supplied.
matched_action: Qwen3.5-27B S3 tie-adjusted probabilities for each control and layer from the matched action summary. The uncontrolled curve matches summary.csv exactly. VARC and the 132-feature visual baseline are manuscript values for input-output q25. All probabilities are fractions.
embedding: Coordinates and encoded support grids copied without recomputation from the historical embedding export. Cleanup maps to CleanUp; Extract maps to ExtractObjects. Task links retain their identities, but support grids may differ from the newer ConceptARC-100-8 dataset.
